name: TextSpace
tagline: A local-first word processor with paginated paper, built in C#
summary: TextSpace is an independent, local-first word processor built in C#, Uno Platform, SkiaSharp and HarfBuzz. Its ribbon, paginated editing surface, navigation panes, review tools and file workflows are reusable .NET controls—not an embedded web editor. Documents are processed locally with rolling recovery snapshots, and interchange covers native .textspace, bounded DOCX, PDF/PNG, HTML and plain text.

heroStats.label: accounts, uploads or AI services required

highlights.title: Paginated paper
highlights.text: Mixed-size sections, columns, per-section numbering, first/even/default headers and footers, paragraph keeps and widow control.

highlights.title: A familiar ribbon
highlights.text: A custom ribbon with Home, Insert, Design, Layout, References, Mailings, Review, View and Help, plus contextual table and picture tabs.

highlights.title: HarfBuzz typography
highlights.text: HarfBuzz metrics with aligned tab stops and leaders, styles, paragraph spacing and discretionary or nonbreaking characters.

highlights.title: Live fields and contents
highlights.text: Seventeen field types with F9 updates, locks, sequences and REF/PAGEREF, plus a linked, rebuildable table of contents.

highlights.title: Merged and nested tables
highlights.text: Rectangular merges, split-to-grid, nested tables, header-row repetition, vertical alignment and row splitting.

highlights.title: Navigation and review
highlights.text: Heading outline, page previews, search/replace, bookmarks, safe links, comments with replies and guarded change rejection.

highlights.title: Real interchange
highlights.text: Native .textspace, bounded DOCX import/export, PDF and PNG rendering, HTML and plain text, and CSV mail merge.

highlights.title: Recovery Center
highlights.text: Rolling IndexedDB/native snapshots, previewed repair and checksum-verified protected originals—without clearing your data.

items: Rich runs with paragraph splitting and joining
Grapheme-safe selections and transactional editing
Bounded undo/redo and native platform text input
Templates, import/export and rolling local history in the File backstage
Font metadata, emphasis, colors and paragraph styles
Left, center, right, decimal and bar tabs with six leader styles
Discretionary and nonbreaking characters via Insert → Special Characters
Rich-run-aware wrapping without artificial break opportunities
Next, odd, even-page, continuous and next-column section starts
Per-section paper size, orientation, margins, columns and numbering
First/even/default plain-text headers and footers with placeholders
Widow/orphan control, keep with next, keep lines together, page break before
Balanced paragraph-only column bands on shared pages
17 allowlisted field types including PAGE, NUMPAGES, SEQ, REF and PAGEREF
F9 updates, Manage Fields, locking and unlinking
Numeric switches for Arabic, Roman and alphabetic display
Generated table of contents with linked entries and dot leaders
Rectangular cell merges and split-to-grid
Nested tables and in-cell or in-flow pictures
First-header-row repetition, row splitting and minimum heights
Top/middle/bottom vertical alignment in cells
Heading outline and page previews
Search and replace
Bookmarks with atomic internal-link rename
Safe HTTP/HTTPS/mailto links and internal #bookmark links
Comments, replies and resolution with guarded local change rejection
Rolling IndexedDB (browser) or native snapshots
Actionable Recovery Center at startup instead of a reload-only error
Preview tab-stop repair before protecting the original
SHA-256-addressed protected originals that are never automatically evicted
Recovery → Open and Repair for native files

codeSamples.title: Edit, bookmark and export DOCX/PDF
Publish the browser app
codeSamples.code:
dotnet workload install wasm-tools
dotnet publish src/TextSpace.App -f net10.0-browserwasm -c Release \
  -p:WasmShellWebAppBasePath=/TextSpace/ -o artifacts/publish
python3 scripts/collect-site.py artifacts/publish site
python3 scripts/serve-site.py site --port 4173

playground.intro: The live browser build is the full C#/Skia word processor—write, paginate and export without an account or upload.

tour.title: Start from the backstage
tour.text: Open File to browse templates, import/export options and rolling local history.

tour.title: Mix page layouts
tour.text: Choose Layout → Section Break → Continuous Section, then set Columns for the new section to see balanced column bands share a physical page.

tour.title: Insert live fields
tour.text: Use Insert → Field to add PAGE or NUMWORDS, edit text, then press F9 or choose Update Fields. Try References → Table of Contents on Heading-styled text.

tour.title: Merge and nest tables
tour.text: Place the caret in a table and use Table Layout → Merge Cells, Split Cell or Nested Table; Tab moves between anchor cells.

tour.title: Bookmark and link
tour.text: Select text and open Insert → Navigation → Bookmark, then add Insert → Link with #YourBookmark and Ctrl-click to follow it.

tour.title: Export your work
tour.text: Export the document as DOCX, PDF, a web page, plain text or a page image from the File backstage.

architecture.name: Document model
architecture.text: UI-independent rich document model with persistent paragraph IDs and typographic-point geometry.

architecture.name: Engines and interchange
architecture.text: Serialization, transactional editing, deterministic pagination, bounded DOCX and recovery storage without UI dependencies.

architecture.name: Rendering
architecture.text: SkiaSharp and HarfBuzz implement text metrics and paint the same geometry on screen and in PDF/PNG.

architecture.name: Uno surfaces
architecture.text: Custom ribbon and office controls plus the embeddable paginated editor with native text input.

architecture.name: Workbench
architecture.text: Assembles commands, backstage, recovery, navigation and review behind the IWorkspaceHost abstraction.

boundaries: Not Microsoft Word: no identical pagination, pixel-identical appearance or lossless DOCX round-tripping
Footnotes/endnotes, equations, floating drawings and rich independent header/footer stories are unfinished
No collaboration, macros or add-ins; the offline Editor checks style, not full spelling or grammar
AutoSave is device-local and abrupt termination can lose debounced edits—keep independent backups
Browser tests use Chromium; Safari, Firefox, mobile, IME and screen-reader parity need more validation
